purpose: Final runtime-overhead benchmark for Reviewer 1 Comment 6.
deployment_configuration: Conservative maximal final configuration: base/veto detector dependencies + Table-5 speed-alter targeted branch + D-LLM/D-out consistency. This configuration contains the largest hook set among the three final targets.

dependency_audit.note: v26_vision_model is a required stage-summary hook and is distinct from the separate v26 online-head capture.

benchmark.note: This package benchmarks the deployment-optimized monitor. Percentile statistics use the frozen bounded deterministic approximation described in percentile_deployment_optimization.

excluded_from_latency: dataloader iteration outside the inference timer
memory_reporting: per-component directly accounted CPU working/resident memory
total accounted CPU monitor working memory and percentage of baseline VLA RSS
paired incremental GPU peak and percentage of baseline GPU peak
raw process-RSS deltas retained only as diagnostics
auxiliary_cpu_reporting: normalized percentage of logical CPU capacity
large_tensor_quantile: Same linear p95/p99 definition. torch.quantile for ordinary tensors; torch.kthvalue order statistics + linear interpolation for large tensors that exceed the CUDA torch.quantile element-count limit.

percentile_deployment_optimization.sampling: deterministic evenly distributed midpoint sampling over the flattened tensor
percentile_deployment_optimization.reason: Bound percentile cost for very large autoregressive activations/logits; avoid full-tensor sort/order-statistic cost while retaining percentile semantics.

synchronization_profiler.purpose: Quantify synchronization overhead requested by Reviewer 2.
